trusted_assumptions: ManuallyDrop<T> has T's layout and bit validity, so the mutable-reference cast preserves current and final values.
ManuallyDrop::take returns the contained value without changing the slot and cannot unwind.
ManuallyDrop::new preserves its input value and cannot unwind.
rationale: The unsupported raw-pointer intrinsic is desugared into a straight-line ManuallyDrop exchange; Verus proves both swap postconditions and no_unwind.
